description: creationLockConfig disarm fixture: campaignBound IS present (which alone would arm the automatic lock, per EV-009) but creationLockConfig{auto:false} explicitly switches it off. Spend of 85 crosses DATA.level1AP (79). Asserts the explicit off-switch beats the campaign-membership default — 'Halfling: Brave' prices at the creation rate (2), not the locked tier-2 rate (4). This is the DM turning automatic locking off for a campaign.

events.label: DM switched automatic creation lock OFF
Species trait — Halfling: Brave (auto-lock disarmed, creation rate)
